body: Here is a consequence of adding a feature w/o any test. https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/bf26eb84626e634fe98e958a4105d09633c61a6f#diff-fc5bfcac2e033b00de4f2bfe6b02a1ac
This looks like the commit that broke the feature: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/0d3335d47a2fdb31f5e387b31d4bd68de03612da#diff-fc5bfcac2e033b00de4f2bfe6b02a1ac

Apparently they are no longer specified in the plugin, but in the application.properties: 
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/41b3c45375811c8823e6dc0ed7ee67a549c47b9e/core/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/deployment/pkg/PackageConfig.java#L58-L62


I tried adding these to the `application.properties` but it still didn't work:

```properties
quarkus.package.user-configured-ignored-entries=META-INF/swagger-ui-files/swagger-ui-bundle.js.map,META-INF/swagger-ui-files/swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js.map
```

I'm investigating it

Probably `quarkus.package.user-configured-ignored-entries` is processed before the uberJar is created. I am looking for a way to get rid of unnecessary files from the uberJar that come from maven dependencies.

issue.title: GeneratedResourceBuildItem may also be filtered and ignoredEntries from plugins is now used
